message: EXEC SQL INCLUDE SQLCA (line 16) sits under 01 WS-DB2-AREA and COPY ERRHND (line 27) under 01 WS-ERROR-AREA, but the copybook records SQL-STATUS-CODES and ERROR-HANDLING are themselves level 01. Registered as EXPANDS_COPY from the enclosing 01 records (SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0066-REC-0001, SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0066-REC-0003) as written; their total_bytes (35, 174) include the copybook records.

EXEC SQL INCLUDE SQLCA (line 16) expands to copybook SQLCA (SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0017), which defines only SQL-STATUS-CODES (35 bytes). The precompiler SQLCA items (SQLCODE, SQLSTATE, ...) are not defined in the repository copybook.
